roles.A: An original male American basketball play-by-play announcer in his thirties. Bright resonant mid-baritone, crisp consonants, athletic breath support, slightly gritty texture. Natural conversational North American English. Fast compact phrases, rhythmic pauses, rising anticipation, strong but controlled excitement on the made basket. Speak as if watching the action courtside, never like reading an advertisement. No imitation of a named person. Voice only, no music or crowd effects.
roles.B: An original male American basketball color analyst in his fifties. Deep warm bass-baritone with a relaxed, mildly husky texture, clearly different from the play-by-play host. Natural North American English, conversational and observant. Explain one detail at a time with confident short phrases, clear emphasis and real pauses. Warm engagement rather than flat narration. No imitation of a named person. Voice only, no music or crowd effects.

cues.subtitleZh: 一次防守，仍有下一次机会。
cues.direction: Confident opening hook, compact, warm anticipation.

cues.text: Christie drives. Houston closes the lane.
cues.subtitleZh: 克里斯蒂切入，火箭收紧禁区。
cues.direction: Live action call, quick and precise, build anticipation.

cues.text: Freeze it. Look at the help around the ball.
cues.subtitleZh: 暂停看这一拍：球侧的协防正在收紧。
cues.direction: Direct the viewer's attention in a conversational tactical breakdown.

cues.subtitleZh: 被封盖！鲍威尔抢回球权！
cues.direction: Two compact energetic calls. Punch Blocked, then a relieved recovery, not a scream.

cues.text: That rebound gives Dallas another chance.
cues.subtitleZh: 这次前场篮板，给独行侠第二次机会。
cues.direction: Explain the value of the offensive rebound with a warm confident emphasis on another chance.

cues.text: Back to Christie. Time to reset.
cues.subtitleZh: 球回到克里斯蒂，进攻重新组织。
cues.direction: Settle briefly after the scramble; keep a live-broadcast rhythm.

cues.text: Watch the screen, and the space on the right.
cues.subtitleZh: 注意掩护，以及右侧的出手空间。
cues.direction: Calm tactical explanation with short natural phrasing; emphasize screen and space.
Build suspense, brief pause after side-step, sharp rising energy on lets it fly. Do not announce a result.
Explosive made-basket payoff, projected and genuinely surprised, a short breath between phrases. No prolonged screaming.
Warm reaction to the partner's call, then clearly explain the score.
Ask the color analyst a real short question, curious rather than theatrical.

cues.subtitleZh: 撤步拉开空间，防守仍有干扰。
cues.direction: Measured replay analysis with a real pause between the two clauses.

cues.text: The official expected field-goal rate? Just thirty percent.
cues.direction: Explain the metric clearly, conversationally; emphasize thirty percent without presenting it as certainty.
Short satisfied reaction, energized but quieter than the first made-basket call.

cues.text: A second chance. A patient reset. Game Buddy shows you why.
cues.subtitleZh: 篮板续命，耐心重组。GameBuddy，陪你看懂每一拍。
cues.direction: Warm concluding insight, a small pause after each clause, confident brand close without an advertising voice.
